title_as_printed: Experimental LLE Data for [CH4 (1) + CO2 (2) + H2O (3)] at the Upper Critical End Point at Temperatures T and Pressures p, Where xi Denotes the Mole Fraction of Component i and u(xi) Denotes Standard Uncertainty of xi

footnotes_as_printed.a: The phases are labeled as II and III for the CO2-rich liquid and water-rich phases, respectively.

temperature_scale: ITS-90 (PRT calibrated on ITS-90, stated in section 2.3)
pressure_note: UCEP pressure; compositions sampled at about 0.01 to 0.02 MPa above the UCEP pressure (section 2.4)
notes: Upper critical end point Lw + LCO2 = V: two liquids (CO2-rich liquid II, at its critical point with the vapour, and water-rich liquid III). Printed rotated (landscape) on the page; 7 rows, one per temperature 287.65-303.50 K. In the printed header the phase-II rule extends over the first x1 column of phase III; the column order (II: x1..u(x3), III: x1..u(x3)) is unambiguous from the 12 headers and the mole-fraction sums. This mapping: aqueous phase III. 2026-10-11 coordinator: gas_mixture true (two dissolved gases); these rows belong to the ternary family, which the v1.2 builder cannot yet write, so the release excludes them until a ternary converter exists. 2026-10-11 coordinator: ternary mapping (property ternary_state, converter conv_ternary) replacing the per-phase mappings, which are kept as *.json.txt. Al Ghafri numbering: x1 CH4, x2 CO2, x3 H2O. UCEP points: phase II is the CO2-rich liquid (regime lle); its printed water content (6.9e-5 to 2.6e-4) is 10-30 times below Table 5 phase II at nearby states and is not built.
